summary: Executed scoped backend+frontend regression for /admin auth and /ai-consulting base flow. Backend auth/session and base enquiry API mostly pass, but admin cookie policy violates required SameSite=Strict and browser /ai-consulting submission proof remains blocked by dropdown interaction instability.

critical.issue: Set-Cookie for __Host-bb-admin returned SameSite=None; Partitioned instead of required SameSite=Strict.

ui_bugs.issue: Keyboard/typeahead flow for stage/timeline/budget did not reliably persist selected values, leaving required fields invalid at submit.
Consent checkbox interaction was blocked/unreliable when dropdown remained open in overlay state.

integration_issues.flow: Real base form submission with disabled/loading guard verification
integration_issues.issue: Could not complete end-to-end browser success path after 3 attempts due dropdown state/selection instability; therefore immediate Submitting…/spinner/aria-busy and one-POST browser proof could not be conclusively validated.
Browser automation did not produce a clean pass signal for dashboard redirect in this run, while API-level auth flow with current env credentials passed.

issues: Open dropdown overlay can persist across section boundaries and interfere with lower control interactions.

action_items: Fix admin auth cookie attributes to enforce SameSite=Strict for __Host-bb-admin in deployed response path.
Stabilize Radix dropdown keyboard/typeahead selection persistence on base /ai-consulting (stage, timeline, estimatedBudget, budgetStatus).
Ensure open dropdown does not block consent checkbox and submit interactions.
Re-run browser proof for one real submission: immediate disabled/loading state, exactly one POST, success text, reference, locked controls, and DB record cleanup by exact created ID.
critical_code_review_comments: security_sessions.cookie() sets samesite='strict', but live Set-Cookie observed as SameSite=None; Partitioned, indicating attribute mutation in runtime/deployment path that breaks requirement.

SecurityGateway correctly applies CSRF+cookie auth for admin and form-context token for public forms; backend canonical punctuation persistence for stage/timeline/budget/budgetStatus passed API regression.
Legacy backend tests using Bearer admin token are stale versus current cookie+CSRF flow and should be retired to prevent false confidence.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary QA ai-consulting enquiry via API test and deleted only the exact created id in teardown/finally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stopped additional Playwright rewrites after 3 failed attempts on same dropdown/submit path per loop-prevention. Last attempts used keyboard (ArrowDown/typeahead/Enter/Escape) plus direct option testids; selection state still dropped before submit. Browser auth was attempted with current env credentials without printing secrets; API auth regression proved login/verify/logout success. Focus next on dropdown state management and deployed cookie attribute mutation source.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (security): Application code sets Strict cookies, but observed response cookie arrives as SameSite=None; Partitioned, likely mutated after app-layer (proxy/edge/runtime cookie policy), causing requirement mismatch. RCA-2 (frontend): Dropdown state can remain open or lose selected values under keyboard/typeahead progression; resulting validation failures prevent reaching submitting state and one-POST proof in browser flow.
